title: Learning From Others' Mistakes: Avoiding Dataset Biases Without Modeling Them

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance on the HANS dataset, specifically on heuristic-non-entailed examples where high word overlap exists but the label is not entailment, and analyzing weak learner errors on MNLI.
Analyzing the correlation between negation words in the hypothesis and 'contradiction' predictions made by a weak learner trained on MNLI.
Evaluating model performance on the Adversarial SQuAD dataset (AddSent and AddOneSent), which appends distractor sentences to passages to fool models relying on keyword-matching heuristics.
Evaluating model performance on the FEVER Symmetric Test Set, which balances claim artifacts to prevent models from relying solely on claim-only features (without evidence).
Injecting a 'cheating feature' (a specific prefix correlated with the label) into the training data and measuring the extent to which models rely on this artificial bias.
